name: Ashley Byrd
life: “I still remember watching a dress change shape around a seated body.” Friday often includes a stop at the downtown fountain, where Ashley keeps a little time free to hear who is playing at the far end of the park.
voice: I fitted a skirt in the salon. The client could sit while I pinned it for the first time in years.
appearance: Ashley has a small notch in the left eyebrow. Look for short, uneven waves that refuse to lie flat. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a gray fisher's sweater with a cloth patch so neatly matched it only shows in strong light. In conversation Ashley presses the lips together to keep a smile in.
personality: Ashley treats keeping somebody waiting as a serious discourtesy. This can turn a helpful person into an impatient one when everybody else needs a slower conversation.
agenda: To let the client sit for the skirt fitting.
family: Albert Barclay is Ashley’s first cousin once removed. Ashley makes room at the table. Albert brings whatever was actually growing or affordable that week. The meal sometimes produces a solution. Even when it does not, everyone goes away knowing what the other household is up against. Asked about *A widow bids again*, Albert says, “I want a bench in the entry for those of us who take stairs in stages.”
connections: Nadia Black (bridal stylist). They put the mirror at a height that lets a seated customer choose when to look.

reactions.situation: The mirror owner wants it back during a fitting
reactions.response: Ashley asks the two shops for enough time to finish the fitting in privacy.

reactions.situation: A diner goes silent in the middle of a noisy family celebration
reactions.response: Ashley asks one close relative to check in privately instead of stopping the party for a public inquiry.

reactions.response: Ashley changes the plan openly and takes responsibility for the delay.
